## Summary / Bio
Aditya Kumar Srivastava is a Full-Stack Java Developer and Software Engineer II with over 4 years of hands-on experience building, scaling, and maintaining high-performance enterprise web applications. He specializes in microservices architecture, RESTful API design, Redis caching, PostgreSQL database tuning, modern React.js frontend development, and cloud deployment on AWS.

Currently, he serves as a Software Engineer II at CGM ARIA Health Services (CGM APEasy Team). Previously, he spent nearly 4 years at Cognizant Technology Solutions, where he engineered full-stack applications serving over 100,000 active users with 99.9% uptime, reduced API response times by 40%, and reduced CI/CD deployment times by 87%.

He holds certifications as an AWS Certified Developer – Associate, AWS Certified Cloud Practitioner, and GitHub Foundations, and is actively integrating AI/LLM capability into Java applications using Spring AI.
